plain_description: OLMo gives AI researchers and enterprises a complete open-source stack to train, fine-tune, and deploy state-of-the-art language models from 1B to 32B parameters. It provides the code, configs, and checkpoints needed to reproduce production-grade LLMs without starting from scratch. The bottom line: skip building your own training infrastructure and use a proven, fully open platform.
technical_description: OLMo is a Python library for training, evaluating, and serving large language models using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers. It implements a two-stage pretraining pipeline that trains on web-scale data followed by curated high-quality data, with distributed training orchestrated via torchrun and YAML-based configuration files. The library supports model quantization through bitsandbytes, publishes checkpoints in both native and Hugging Face formats, and includes an OpenAI-compatible API server deployable on Modal.com. Inference is available via the Hugging Face transformers API with text-generation pipeline support.
title: OLMo
